name: Speak to Nafien
summary: Nafien stands guard outside Timbermaw Hold in Felwood. You are asked to travel north along the main road and speak with him.

sections.title: Road North
sections.body: In Felwood, Nafien keeps watch outside the entrance to Timbermaw Hold. You are asked to find him by traveling north along the main road.

faq.answer: Nafien is a furbolg who stands guard outside the entrance to Timbermaw Hold.
Nafien stands outside the entrance to Timbermaw Hold in Felwood, along the main road to the north.

faq.q: What am I asked to do?
faq.answer: Travel north along Felwood's main road and speak with Nafien.

attribution: In-game quest text: Speak to Nafien
